breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained both 'Explicit forward Euler' as the time_integration method and 'Strang splitting' with exact sub-step solvers, which are contradictory. The ground truth removes the forward Euler line entirely. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of forward Euler and specifies only 'Strang splitting with FFT-based exact diffusion solve and exact logistic ODE solution,' matching the ground truth's resolution.
